Population increased in Forest of Dean

The estimated population of Forest of Dean in 2024 was 89,753 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that Forest of Dean's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Forest of Dean increased by 3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Forest of Dean was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Forest of Dean

The average (median) age fell to 48.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Forest of Dean has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Forest of Dean is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Forest of Dean's population of 89,753 usual residents was made up of:

  • 14,424 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.1%)
  • 52,360 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.3%)
  • 22,969 people aged 65 years and over, (25.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Forest of Dean has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Forest of Dean, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Forest of Dean
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Forest of Dean, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 270 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 746 births and 1,016 deaths in Forest of Dean.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 857 (1%). There were 5,323 people entering the area and 4,466 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Forest of Dean's population of 488 (0.5%) as a result of 700 people entering the area and 212 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Forest of Dean was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Forest of Dean in mid-2023 is 89,050.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 159 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 213 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 54 people.
